XVI.|TO THE ROMANES.|421}}</noinclude>{{dropinitial|A|image=Rhemes New Testament 1582 initial A, a bearded man.png|imgsize=115px|fl={{verse|chapter=16|verse=1}}}}ND I commend to you Phœbè our sister, vvho is in the ministerie of the Church that is in Cenchris: {{verse|chapter=16|verse=2}}† that you receiue her in our Lord as it is vvorthie for saincts: and that you assist her in whatsoeuer busines she shal neede you. for she also hath assisted many and my self.

{{verse|chapter=16|verse=3}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ The onely salutation of so vvorthy a man is sufficient to fil him with greate grace that is so saluted. ''Chrys. in 2. Tim. 4''.}}∷ Salute Prisca and Aquila my helpers in Christ {{sc|Iesvs}}, {{verse|chapter=16|verse=4}}† (vvho for my life haue laid dovvne their neckes: to whom not I only giue thankes, but also al the Churches of the Gentiles) {{verse|chapter=16|verse=5}}† and their {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ This domestical Church was either that faithful and Christian houshold, or rather the Christians meeting together there & in such good houses to heare diuine seruice and the Apostles preaching in those times of persecution.}}∷ domestical Church. Salute Epænetus my beloued: vvho is the first fruite of Asia in Christ. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=6}}† Salute Marie vvho hath laboured much about vs. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=7}}† Salute Andrónicus and {{MarginNote|margin=left|margin-width=65|text=''`Iunia''}}`Iulia' my cosins and fellovv captiues: vvho are noble among the Apostles, vvho also before me vvere in Christ. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=8}}† Salute Ampliátus my best beloued in our Lord. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=9}}† Salute Vrbánus our helper in Christ {{sc|Iesvs}}, and Stachys my beloued. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=10}}† Salute Apelles {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ ''τὸν δόκιμον''}}∷ approued in Christ. Salute them that are of Aristóbolus house. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=11}}† Salute Herodion my kinsman. Salute them that are of Narcissus house, that are in our Lord. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=12}}† Salute Tryphæna and Tryphósa: vvho labour in our Lord. Salute Persis the beloued, vvho hath much laboured in our Lord. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=13}}† Salute Rufus the elect in our Lord and his mother and mine. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=14}}† {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ The Protestants here reason thus, Peter is not here saluted, therfore he was neuer at Rome. See the Annotation.}}∷ Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Pátrobas, Hermes: and the brethren that are vvith them. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=15}}† Salute Philólogus and Iulia, Nereus, and his sister and Olympias: and al the saincts that are vvith them. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=16}}† {{sup|‖}} Salute one an other in a {{sup|‖}} holy kisse. Al the churches of Christ salute you.

{{verse|chapter=16|verse=17}}† And I desire you brethren, {{sup|‖}} to marke them that make dissensions and scandals contrarie to the doctrine vvhich you haue {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ Of the Prince of the Apostles, saith Theodorete vpon this place.}}∷ learned, and auoid them. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=18}}† For such doe not serue Christ our Lord, {{sup|‖}} but their ovvne belly: and {{MarginNote|margin=right|margin-width=65|text=∷ The special way that Heretikes haue euer had to beguile, vvas and is by sweete vvordes & gay speaches. Which their sheepes cote see before described particularly in the Annotations vpon S. Matthew. ''c. 7, 15''.}}∷ by svveete speaches and benedictions seduce the hartes of innocents. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=19}}† For {{sup|‖}} your obedience is published into euery place. I reioyce therfore in you. But I vvould haue you to be vvise in good, and simple in euil. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=20}}† And the God of peace crush Satan vnder your feete quickely. The grace of our Lord {{sc|Iesvs}} Christ be vvith you.

{{verse|chapter=16|verse=21}}† Timothee my coadiutor saluteth you, and Lucius, and Iason, and Sosípater, my kinsmen. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=22}}† I Tertius salute you, that vvrote the epistle, in our Lord. {{verse|chapter=16|verse=23}}† Caius mine host, and<noinclude>{{rh||Ggg iij|the}}</noinclude>
